prompt: Create a highly detailed vertical anime-style fantasy portrait of a graceful young shrine maiden standing in three-quarter view and looking back over her shoulder with a calm, slightly wistful expression. She has long glossy black hair, soft pale skin, delicate facial features, blue-gray eyes, subtle makeup, and wispy bangs; her hair is tied back loosely and decorated with cascading white and blue floral hair ornaments, tiny gold chains, and long tassels. She wears an elegant white and deep indigo kimono with fine gold embroidery, blue floral patterns, a dark blue collar, and a large ornate obi bow on her back featuring geometric cut-glass starburst patterns. Behind her is one large luminous white fox spirit with sharp elegant ears, narrow blue eyes, flowing fur, and curling ribbon-like tails, positioned protectively over her shoulder. The setting is a dazzling Edo Kiriko cut-glass world: deep cobalt blue glass panels, transparent crystalline arcs, gold metal framing, etched starburst and flower geometry, reflective facets, and sparkling highlights. Add exactly 5 prominent floral clusters: one large cascading cluster in her hair, one branch of white blossoms at the left edge, one branch of white blossoms at the lower right, one large vivid blue flower cluster at the bottom right, and one small white blossom cluster near the fox tail. Use a palette of cobalt blue, white, silver, and subtle gold, with dramatic backlighting, luminous rim light, glass refractions, fine linework, intricate kimono textile detail, soft depth of field, and a luxurious magical atmosphere. Vertical composition, close-up waist portrait, no text, no watermark, no extra characters.
